The lojban (email) mailing list was started in 1989 by Eric S. Raymond. By 1991, it had outgrown its initial host and was moved to a Columbia University LISTSERV. In 1994, it surpassed 100 subscribers. In 2002, additional specialized lists were created: [[jboske]] ("lojbanology") for technical discussion of the language, and [[lojban-beginners]] for learners. 

[[Image:lojban-list-by-year.png|800px]]

As of July 2014, the top all-time contributors to the list were [[rlpowell]], [[lojbab]] and [[xorxes]].

See "[[Lojbanic forums]]" for a discussion of the mailing list's relation to other forums.
